blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A firearm was confiscated from a 13-year-old student at school in President Quirino, Sultan Kudarat, the Philippine National Police (PNP) reported. According to the PNP, a 9mm pistol with eight rounds of ammunition was found inside the student’s bag. Authorities recovered the firearm and ammunition after the student voluntarily opened his bag during inspection at the school guardhouse on Monday. The minor was brought to the President Quirino Municipal Police station accompanied by his parents. He was also referred to the Women and Children Protection Desk for appropriate intervention in accordance with the laws and child protection procedures. […]...
